Usage

Every icon is exported as a plain SVG string, so there is no component layer and no runtime. Install the package, pull in the icon you want, and render the string with whatever your framework calls its raw HTML escape hatch.

Install

Get an icon

Each collection has its own entry point, because the same name exists in more than one of them. Names are PascalCase versions of the original file names, so arrow-up-right.svg becomes ArrowUpRight.

{source.modulePath} {source.label}

Render it

The same icon, written the idiomatic way in each framework -- pick your tab. Nothing here is olum-icons-specific: the string goes wherever your framework accepts raw HTML.

Sizing and colour

Every icon uses currentColor, so it takes the colour of the text around it. Each one is normalised to a height of 24 with no width, so set only the height and let the width follow the viewBox -- that keeps Font Awesome's variable-width icons undistorted.
